block.claudemod.prismium_cell.usage: Right-click empty-handed to open its GUI; right-click with a Prismium Shard to charge it directly, or place it next to a Prismium Generator/Cable for automatic charging.
block.claudemod.prismium_cell.details: A portable battery block: it just stores FE (Forge Energy) so it can be carried, placed, and drained again elsewhere - the mod's basic energy storage building block, with no generation or consumption logic of its own.
block.claudemod.prismium_generator.usage: Right-click with a Prismium Shard to add fuel instantly, or drop shards into its GUI fuel slot to auto-feed one at a time; it slowly generates FE while burning and auto-pushes it to adjacent energy blocks.
block.claudemod.prismium_generator.detai: This mod's basic power source: it burns Prismium Shards as fuel to generate FE over time, similar in role to a furnace but producing energy instead of smelting items.
block.claudemod.prismium_cable.usage: Place between two energy blocks to relay FE between them automatically.
block.claudemod.prismium_cable.details: A passive conduit block: it has no energy storage or generation of its own, and only exists to relay FE between the energy blocks on either side of it.
item.claudemod.prismium_rift_shard.usage: Right-click to teleport to the Prism Realm; right-click again while there to return to where you left from.
item.claudemod.prismium_rift_shard.detai: A reusable key between worlds: right-click to open a rift to the Prism Realm, and right-click again once there to return - it is not consumed by use.
message.claudemod.prismium_generator.fue: Fed Prismium Generator: %1$ss of fuel remaining
message.claudemod.prismium_pulse_charm.f: Danger sensed: %1$s hostile(s) nearby, now glowing
block.claudemod.prismium_pylon.usage: Consumes FE to grant Regeneration to nearby players.
block.claudemod.prismium_pylon.details: A protection-themed support block: once charged, it automatically spends its own stored FE to keep nearby players regenerating health, with no input from the player required.
block.claudemod.prismium_restorer.usage: Consumes FE to repair the durability of held/nearby items.
block.claudemod.prismium_restorer.detail: A support block themed around repair: once charged, it automatically spends its own stored FE to mend the durability of nearby damaged tools and armor over time.
block.claudemod.prismium_wardstone.usage: Consumes FE to weaken nearby hostile mobs.
block.claudemod.prismium_wardstone.detai: A defensive support block: once charged, it automatically spends its own stored FE to continuously weaken hostile mobs that wander near it.
item.claudemod.prismium_rift_anchor.usag: Right-click to set your respawn point at your current location, in any dimension. Consumed on use.
item.claudemod.prismium_rift_anchor.deta: A one-shot variant of the Rift Shard: a single-use ticket to or from the Prism Realm, consumed on activation rather than reusable.
block.claudemod.prismium_chronoflame.usa: Hold a Clock and right-click to advance the current dimension's time by 6 hours; hold a Clock and sneak + right-click to rewind it by 6 hours. Clicking without a Clock in hand does nothing (prevents accidental triggers). Shows the remaining seconds while on cooldown. Does not drop itself when broken.
item.claudemod.prismium_pickaxe.usage: Mining Prismium Ore has a 25% chance to drop an extra Prismium Shard.
item.claudemod.prismium_pickaxe.details: A pickaxe forged from Prismium, sitting above diamond in mining tier and durability - the only tool tier that can correctly harvest Prismium Core.
item.claudemod.prismium_axe.usage: Chopping logs has a 20% chance to drop an extra log of the same kind.
item.claudemod.prismium_axe.details: An axe forged from Prismium, sitting above diamond in mining tier, durability and attack damage.
item.claudemod.prismium_shovel.usage: Digging gravel has a 50% chance to drop an extra Flint.
item.claudemod.prismium_shovel.details: A shovel forged from Prismium, sitting above diamond in mining tier and durability.
item.claudemod.prismium_hoe.usage: Right-click crops or saplings to grow them instantly, like Bone Meal, without consuming any.
item.claudemod.prismium_hoe.details: A hoe forged from Prismium, sitting above diamond in mining tier and durability.
item.claudemod.prismium_sword.usage: Landing a hit has a 15% chance to briefly inflict Glowing on the target.
item.claudemod.prismium_sword.details: A sword forged from Prismium, sitting above diamond in attack damage and durability.
item.claudemod.prismium_helmet.usage: Wearing the full Prismium armor set (all 4 pieces) grants permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_helmet.details: The helmet of the Prismium armor set - above diamond in defense, and part of a set whose full 4-piece bonus is permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_chestplate.usage: Wearing the full Prismium armor set (all 4 pieces) grants permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_chestplate.detai: The chestplate of the Prismium armor set - above diamond in defense, and part of a set whose full 4-piece bonus is permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_leggings.usage: Wearing the full Prismium armor set (all 4 pieces) grants permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_leggings.details: The leggings of the Prismium armor set - above diamond in defense, and part of a set whose full 4-piece bonus is permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_boots.usage: Wearing the full Prismium armor set (all 4 pieces) grants permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_boots.details: The boots of the Prismium armor set - above diamond in defense, and part of a set whose full 4-piece bonus is permanent Night Vision and Water Breathing.
item.claudemod.prismium_featherstone.usa: No need to equip it - just carrying one anywhere in your inventory reduces fall damage to 25%.
item.claudemod.prismium_featherstone.det: A passive charm: no need to equip it, just carrying one anywhere in your inventory quietly reduces fall damage.
item.claudemod.prismium_emberguard.usage: No need to equip it - just carrying one anywhere in your inventory halves fire/lava damage.
item.claudemod.prismium_emberguard.detai: A passive charm: no need to equip it, just carrying one anywhere in your inventory quietly reduces fire and lava damage.
item.claudemod.prismium_magnet_charm.usa: No need to equip it - just carrying one anywhere in your inventory pulls nearby dropped items toward you.
item.claudemod.prismium_magnet_charm.det: A passive charm: no need to equip it, just carrying one anywhere in your inventory quietly draws nearby dropped items in.
item.claudemod.prismium_vitastone.usage: No need to equip it - just carrying one anywhere in your inventory multiplies healing received by 1.2x.
item.claudemod.prismium_vitastone.detail: A passive charm: no need to equip it, just carrying one anywhere in your inventory quietly amplifies any healing you receive.
item.claudemod.prismium_guardian_charm.u: Hold it in your hand: the instant you would take fatal damage, it is consumed to save you at 1 health with Regeneration + Absorption + Fire Resistance.
item.claudemod.prismium_guardian_charm.d: A one-time safety net: held in hand, it silently waits until you would otherwise die, then sacrifices itself to save you - a Prismium parallel to the vanilla Totem of Undying.
item.claudemod.prismium_grappling_hook.u: Right-click while aiming at a block to pull yourself toward it.
item.claudemod.prismium_grappling_hook.d: A mobility tool for exploration: fires toward whatever block you're aiming at and reels you in, letting you cross gaps or scale cliffs without building.
item.claudemod.prismium_locator.usage: Right-click to scan for nearby Prismium Ore and show its direction and distance.
item.claudemod.prismium_locator.details: A detection tool: scans the area around you for the nearest Prismium Ore and reports its direction and distance, without needing to dig blindly.
item.claudemod.prismium_pulse_charm.usag: Right-click to sense nearby hostile mobs, making them glow (visible through walls) for 10 seconds.
item.claudemod.prismium_pulse_charm.deta: A crafted detection charm that resonates with hostile creatures' presence, letting the holder sense danger before it strikes - a defensive counterpart to the Locator's ore-finding.
item.claudemod.prismium_shield.usage: Hold right-click to raise it and block incoming attacks.
item.claudemod.prismium_shield.details: A shield forged with Prismium, functioning like a vanilla shield to block incoming attacks while raised.
item.claudemod.prismium_bow.usage: Arrows fired from this bow pierce through and hit one extra target.
item.claudemod.prismium_bow.details: A bow forged with Prismium: its arrows pierce through targets, letting a single shot hit more than one enemy in a line.
block.claudemod.prismium_pulverizer.usag: Drop a Silk Touch-mined Prismium Ore/Deepslate Prismium Ore into its GUI input slot; consumes FE over time to grind it into 3 Prismium Shards.
block.claudemod.prismium_pulverizer.deta: The mod's first item-processing machine: an FE-powered grinder that turns a whole ore block back into a guaranteed batch of shards, giving Silk Touch mining of this mod's ore a second use.
block.claudemod.prismium_smelter.usage: Drop Prismium Shards into its GUI input slot; consumes FE over time to refine 4 shards into 1 Prismium Ingot.
block.claudemod.prismium_smelter.details: The mod's second item-processing machine, one step past Prismium Pulverizer in the same production chain: Ore -> Shard -> Ingot. Prismium Ingot has no crafting use yet.
item.claudemod.prismium_ingot.details: A refined metal bar produced by Prismium Smelter from Prismium Shards. No crafting recipe uses it yet.
message.claudemod.prismium_chronoflame.c: Chronoflame can't be used again for %1$s more second(s)
tooltip.claudemod.no_details: No further details for this item yet.
